newsitem.title: USA: Little impact seen from GM strike on Oct U.S. jobs.
newsitem.headline: Little impact seen from GM strike on Oct U.S. jobs.

text.p: Thomas Plewes, an associate commissioner at the Bureau of Labor Statistics, said Friday he did not expect to see much of an impact from the General Motors strike on the U.S. unemployment figures for October to be released next Friday.

"From our point of view given the timing of the survey week which is very early in the month there won't be very much of an effect," he told Reuters Financial Television, adding "I don't think we can quantify it at this point."
Asked when recent wage increases are going to be translated into higher inflation as employers raise prices to offset wage hikes, he said he didn't know but so far it has not been a problem.

"Certainly so far, we have seen that manufacturers and other employers have been able to give wage increases without adding too much to the price (but) I don't know how much room they're going to have in the future," he said. "Certainly we are going to have to watch that very carefully."
